name: ai-shifu
description: AI-Shifu course production expert that helps you quickly build an AI-Shifu course.

displayDescription.en: Based on your teaching needs and source materials (PPT, Word, PDF, txt, etc.), helps you quickly build a one-on-one interactive AI course.
displayDescription.zh: 基于你的教学需求和原始内容(PPT、Word、PDF、txt等)，帮你快速做门AI一对一互动课

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 以「为什么要学习AI」为主题做一个AI师傅课程。整体不超过4个小节，需要针对不同背景的用户来进行个性化授课。希望通过PPT结合文字的方式进行授课，制作完成后直接部署到AI师傅平台
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build an AI-Shifu course on the topic of "Why should I learn AI". Keep it within 4 sections, and personalize the teaching for users from different backgrounds. The teaching should combine PPT slides with text. Once it's ready, deploy it directly to the AI-Shifu platform.

quickPrompts.en: Build an AI-Shifu course on the topic of "Why should I learn AI". Keep it within 4 sections, and personalize the teaching for users from different backgrounds. The teaching should combine PPT slides with text. Once it's ready, deploy it directly to the AI-Shifu platform.
quickPrompts.zh: 以「为什么要学习AI」为主题做一个AI师傅课程。整体不超过4个小节，需要针对不同背景的用户来进行个性化授课。希望通过PPT结合文字的方式进行授课，制作完成后直接部署到AI师傅平台

quickPrompts.en: Help me turn this uploaded material into an AI-Shifu course. The teaching should combine PPT slides with text. Once the conversion is done, deploy it directly to the AI-Shifu platform.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这份上传的素材转成AI师傅课程。希望通过PPT结合文字的方式进行授课，转换完成后直接部署到AI师傅平台

quickPrompts.en: Help me check my courses on the AI-Shifu platform.
quickPrompts.zh: 查看我在 AI 师傅平台上有哪些课程.
